info.name: AISafe - maintenance-service (SIDIS A1)
info.description:
maintenance-service (2 replicas: 8061, 8062). Depends on auth-service (login) and aircraft-service (8081/8082).

1. Start auth-service, aircraft-service and both maintenance replicas.
2. Postman > Settings > General: turn OFF 'SSL certificate verification'.
3. Run folders 00-5 in order (00 saves the tokens; 1 saves the template ids; 2 saves the record id).
4. Stop maintenance-2 and run folder 6. Stop aircraft-service and run folder 7.

exec: pm.test("token saved in token_atcc", () => { pm.collectionVariables.set("token_atcc", pm.response.json().token); });
pm.test("token saved in token_admin", () => { pm.collectionVariables.set("token_admin", pm.response.json().token); });

item.name: List templates on maintenance-1 (both replicas aggregated)

exec: pm.test("templates of both replicas", () => { const n = pm.response.json().map(t => t.name); pm.expect(n).to.include.members(["A-Check Inspection","C-Check Overhaul"]); });

pm.test("save template ids", () => { const ts = pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set("template_ccheck", ts.find(t => t.name === "C-Check Overhaul").id); pm.collectionVariables.set("template_acheck", ts.find(t => t.name === "A-Check Inspection").id); });

item.name: GET C-Check template on maintenance-1 (stored on maintenance-2 -> forwarded)
Create record on maintenance-1 for CS-TMA with the C-Check template of maintenance-2

request.description: Needs aircraft-service: the aircraft must exist. 503 if aircraft-service is down, 404 if the aircraft does not exist.

exec: pm.test("template copied from the other replica", () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().templateName).to.eql("C-Check Overhaul"); });

item.name: GET the new record on maintenance-2 (forwarded to maintenance-1)
Search records of CS-TMB on maintenance-1 (data stored on maintenance-2)
Search by component and date range
3. Workflow (commands forwarded to the owner replica)
Start the record via maintenance-2 (PATCH forwarded) -> aircraft goes to MAINTENANCE
Is CS-TMA under maintenance? (contract for route-flight-service, ATCC token)
Complete with a required task missing -> 409
Complete with end date before start -> 400
Complete the record -> aircraft back to AVAILABLE
Change the component of the record (US217, forwarded)
4. Reports (computed with the data of both replicas)

exec: pm.test("both models", () => { const m = pm.response.json().map(t => t.aircraftModel); pm.expect(m).to.include.members(["A320-200","B737-800"]); });
pm.test("both models", () => { const g = pm.response.json().map(c => c.group); pm.expect(g).to.include.members(["A320-200","B737-800"]); });
pm.test("CS-TMA and CS-TMB", () => { const a = pm.response.json().map(h => h.aircraftRegistration); pm.expect(a).to.include.members(["CS-TMA","CS-TMB"]); });

item.name: US226 parts inventory (FLT-OIL-01 used on both replicas)

exec: pm.test("FLT-OIL-01 aggregated (>= 11)", () => { const p = pm.response.json().find(x => x.partSerialNumber === "FLT-OIL-01"); pm.expect(p.totalQuantityUsed).to.be.at.least(11); });

item.name: US226 low stock (threshold 10: only reached with both replicas)
Internal endpoint called by a client (no service key) -> 403
Fake forwarded call without service key -> 403
6. Failure (STOP maintenance-2 before running)
